title: Rolling picture / screen tears diagonally
backstory: The picture rolls slowly upward. Adjusting the vertical hold control on the monitor chassis has no effect.
visible_effect: Lua overlay draws a dark rolling band scrolling down MAME's output every ~2 seconds
diagnosis_hint: Sync lock failure that can't be corrected with the hold control means the chassis isn't receiving a stable VSYNC signal. Trace the VSYNC line from the PCB connector (J1 pin 9) to the chassis sync separator. A 0.1 µF coupling capacitor often dries out on older chassis.
